The '''CC-7700 frigate''' was an older [[Warship/Legends|warship]] from the [[CC-series capital ship|CC-series]] used in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Characteristics==
The [[Warship/Legends|warship]] was based on its predecessor, the [[Detainer CC-2200/Legends|Detainer CC-2200 interdictor cruiser]]. A product of the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]], it was described as an "older sibling" of the [[DP20 gunship/Legends|Corellian gunship]]. The CC-7700 was designed to serve as a platform for a [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projector]], and was only lightly armed.

The ships had a brig.<ref name="Fate:Conviction" />

==History==
CC-7700s were present at the [[Battle of Mindor]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="LSSOM" /> Shortly after the [[Black Fleet Crisis]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] used a pair of CC-7700 [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] in an [[Battle of Columus (Galactic Civil War)|attempt]] to capture [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala]]. Daala was able to escape after desperately ramming her [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], [[Scylla (frigate)|''Scylla'']], into one of the frigates. However, this action severely damaged ''Scylla'', and Daala's jump into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] was a blind one.<ref name="TNEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> As of [[44 ABY]], at least one such frigate, the ''[[Fireborn]]'', was part of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|Navy]]. It was destroyed in an act of sabotage.<ref name="Fate:Conviction" />

==Behind the scenes==
The CC-7700 frigate was one of several new ships created for the PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]. Specifically, the CC-7700 was included to counter the Imperial [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]]. Besides the [[Bulwark Mark III|''Bulwark''-class battle cruiser]] and [[Dauntless-class heavy cruiser|''Dauntless''-class heavy cruiser]], the CC-7700 is the only new ship class from the game to be mentioned in other [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] sources.

The use of these ships against Admiral Daala was described in the reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'', having been first mentioned in [[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']].
